method: Actual game objects in managed Chromium. Initial six scenarios ran with normal game updates. Vacuum, origin-gem, and rosary screenshots were recaptured with stopped RAF and explicit update/render steps so image state matched measured state. CSS viewports 1280x720 and 390x844; captured device pixels may be larger.

scenarios.evidence: 61 five-XP drops became 60 gem objects holding all 305 XP. Vacuum claimed XP and gold only; one +305 XP · 50 gold callout. Controlled recapture collected 305 base XP and 50 gold with no resources left.
A seven-XP gem at (100,0) survived with the player far away, then awarded exactly seven XP. Recapture placed the camera at the gem while the player was 2610 world units away.

6x/15s followed by 3x/10s kept 6x strength. In the longer-tail case, 6x/5s plus 3x/20s correctly fell to 3x after strong expiry. Live effective stats observed; weapon-cache transition independently covered by the adversarial regression test.

Explosive elites inside blast radius died with rosary cause, kill credit and resources preserved, zero player damage events and HP 100/100. Controlled recapture used zero-speed enemies to exclude contact damage.
Real boss death on a full 20-item floor retained guaranteed chest, vacuum and health orb by evicting three oldest ordinary items. Total remained 20.
Three queued level-ups kept state levelUp, timeScale zero and gameTime frozen through every pick. Progress showed 1/3, 2/3, 3/3. Final-selection grace blocked damage, then expired.

visuals.evidence: Initial capture exposed timer overlap. Corrected capture has timer below the character panel; callout, strength/timer pills and queued cards remain legible without overlap.

cacheNote: Capture initially required cache-disabled reload. Commit 787617c versioned the affected import graph with 20260924-pickups2. Main then verified cold-load resource URLs for ExperienceSystem, RunTimerSystem, CanvasHUD, powerUps and Wraith, followed by an ordinary warm reload: HUD version pickups2, narrow timer layout available, real game started/rendered, zero browser errors.
